purpose: One click-to-edit text field row on a card: it shows the value (or nothing, in view mode, when empty), turns into an input on a click in edit mode, commits on Enter or on leaving, reverts on Escape, and does not treat a click into an open dialog or popover as leaving.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `useCardMode` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-card-mode`; `insideOpenLayer` and `modalIsOpen` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-open-popups`; `BirthdayPicker` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-birthday-picker`; `birthdayText` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-birthday-text` (in the source: `../records/cardMode`, `../records/planLeave`, `../ui/layers`, `gilb-stakeholders-ui`, `gilb-stakeholders`);

the four host imports `ContactLanguagePicker`, `TimeZonePicker`, `contactLanguageDisplay`, `timeZoneDisplay` are optional members of `FieldPickers` (src/fieldPickers.tsx), read with `useFieldPickers()`: `pickedDisplay` takes the pickers as a third argument and calls `pickers.contactLanguageDisplay` / `pickers.timeZoneDisplay` (absent: the value as stored); `const Picker = ...` reads `pickers.ContactLanguagePicker` / `pickers.TimeZonePicker` (with `!`);

added: the function `pickerOf` (null when the host has no component for the asked-for picker), the prop `picker = null` is destructured as `picker: pickerAsked = null`, and the lines `const pickers = useFieldPickers();` and `const picker = pickerOf(pickerAsked, pickers);` follow `const mode = useCardMode();`;
comments made generic (cycle, step and ruling tags, dates, person and app names removed; "(−)" is "remove control"); no other code change.

library.title: Field row (click-to-edit text)
library.note: Needs the card-mode provider; for a controlled form field take field-control. Text, choice and birthday editing; the contact-language and time-zone pickers are optional host members.
